scenarios.name: Change a pending Find value without replacing a listed criterion

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software Find dialog lists Type equals Extrusion and OR Type equals Fillet
Type equals Extrusion is selected with And selected
the user chooses Hole in the Value list
the Value field shows Hole and adds to list is enabled
the listed Extrusion and Fillet criteria remain unchanged
the user selects the Fillet criterion
the controls show Type, equals, Fillet and Or
the user selects the Extrusion criterion
the controls show Type, equals, Extrusion and And
the user closes the Find dialog
